researchQuestion: Can apparently conflicting TWW milling yield claims be explained by separately conditioning on input herb quality and output pigment quality, without inventing economic E or current Retail yields?

sourceAncestry.caveat: Ranges and means are author's beta claims; no cast-level histogram, actual completed-cast count, exact herb/output IDs or live-patch transfer evidence. Mean values reported by author, NOT inferred from bounds.
Approximate 11 vs 13 from one comment; no original casts or outputs, no exact pigment ID, no rank-specific 2026 applicability.

sourceAncestry.claim: Herb quality does not increase pigment amount, only quality

twoAxisContextCorrection.interpretation: Different contrasts, not directly contradictory: one changes OUTPUT pigment quality while holding INPUT herb quality fixed, the other changes INPUT herb quality while holding OUTPUT pigment quality fixed. A single skill multiplier or one-dimensional herb-rank adjustment is unsupported.
twoAxisContextCorrection.importantConflict: Method's generic no-quantity-effect guide conflicts with the November 2024 approximate input-rank contrast at fixed R2 output; source context/patch and actual cast logs must be checked.
twoAxisContextCorrection.application: Keep separate inputRank and outputRank/context axes; do not copy beta or 2024 anecdotes into current Retail E, P or positive range, and do not assume additive 2-pigment coefficients without paired casts.

mappingApplicability.exactInputOutputRankIDAdmission: NONE; sources do not identify exact herb species, output item IDs or recipe variant.

measurementRequest.question: For the same exact herb ID and output pigment ID at R2, do R1 versus R2 herbs produce different zero-inclusive pigment totals per completed 10-herb operation at identical profession skill/spec/gear?
measurementRequest.design: Paired R1/R2 herb cohorts, same profession build, exact recipe spell and pigment rank; capture 200+ completed casts each when feasible, cast-by-cast pigment quantity including zeros, actual herb consumption, Resourcefulness refunds, rejected/aborted operations and build timestamp; record each output item ID and rank. Do not infer P from a yield range.

conclusion: New two-axis rank-conditioning lead; no measured current Retail expectedQuantity and no numeric economic promotion.
